svg.title: Data Shield: end-to-end LLM and tool safety loop
svg.desc: Automatic policy is the main path; human approval is an optional ask + callback branch; missing callbacks fail safe. Audience: User / Integrator / Security reviewer. Scope: Model-bound input and output, tool ingress and egress, optional human callbacks, and the provider tool loop.

text.tspan: LOCAL SHIELD STATE · RAW DATA NEVER ENTERS THE MODEL DIRECTLY

svg.text: Data Shield: end-to-end LLM and tool safety loop
Automatic policy is the main path; human approval is an optional ask + callback branch; missing callbacks fail safe.

text.tspan: allow / deny stay on main path
tool policy → row cap / value match
pass / redact / block use main path
* Raw once is opt-in and audited
